forecast.scope: the zones of the plan it was made with, and what is done already

draft:
In week 50, teams completed 2 visits, with 4 survey and 4 clearance teams active. They worked 37 team-days; 3 team-days were lost to rain or wind. No zones were surveyed or cleared this week. So far, 30 zones have been surveyed, 11 declared free, 33 areas released and 16 cleared.

The access feed shows 19 zones closed. No teams were stood down or had reports overdue by more than a week. No reports were held or queried, and no dossiers were held for missing items. No new plan was approved; the plan is P12.

The forecast made in week 49 covers the zones of the plan it was made with, counting what is done already. Its P10 to P90 range is 11 to 12 mine areas cleared this season and 11 to 11 zones declared free.
